create_hard_tool_judge: create a HardToolJudge instance with a config to perform scripted checks comparing agent and oracle tool call events
create_soft_tool_judge: create a SoftToolJudge instance with an LLM engine config to compare agent and oracle events using soft checkers
create_mild_tool_judge: create a MildToolJudge that combines HardToolJudge and SoftToolJudge to first run hard checks then soft checks
run_hard_tool_judge_compare: run HardToolJudge compare method to validate agent event args match oracle event args using eq or path checkers
run_soft_tool_judge_compare: run SoftToolJudge compare method to validate agent event args against oracle using LLM-based content and tone checkers
